arguments: if [ ! -f "$REMOTE_RELEASE_DIRECTORY/composer.json" ]; then FAILURE_REASON='composer-json-missing'; elif [ ! -f "$REMOTE_RELEASE_DIRECTORY/composer.lock" ]; then FAILURE_REASON='composer-lock-missing'; elif [ -e "$REMOTE_RELEASE_DIRECTORY/vendor" ]; then FAILURE_REASON='vendor-already-present'; elif ! command -v composer >/dev/null 2>&1; then FAILURE_REASON='composer-not-found'; elif ! command -v php >/dev/null 2>&1; then FAILURE_REASON='php-not-found'; else STEP_EXIT_CODE=0; fi
if [ "$STEP_EXIT_CODE" = "0" ]; then cd "$REMOTE_RELEASE_DIRECTORY" && composer validate --no-check-publish --no-interaction >/dev/null 2>&1; STEP_EXIT_CODE=$?; fi
if [ "$STEP_EXIT_CODE" = "0" ]; then cd "$REMOTE_RELEASE_DIRECTORY" && composer check-platform-reqs --lock --no-interaction >/dev/null 2>&1; STEP_EXIT_CODE=$?; fi

COMPOSER_STRATEGY_FINGERPRINT=example-composer-strategy-fingerprint
if [ ! -f "$REMOTE_RELEASE_DIRECTORY/composer.json" ]; then FAILURE_REASON='composer-json-missing'; elif [ ! -f "$REMOTE_RELEASE_DIRECTORY/composer.lock" ]; then FAILURE_REASON='composer-lock-missing'; elif [ -e "$REMOTE_RELEASE_DIRECTORY/vendor" ]; then FAILURE_REASON='vendor-already-present'; elif ! command -v composer >/dev/null 2>&1; then FAILURE_REASON='composer-not-found'; elif ! command -v php >/dev/null 2>&1; then FAILURE_REASON='php-not-found'; else STEP_EXIT_CODE=0; fi
if [ "$STEP_EXIT_CODE" = "0" ]; then cd "$REMOTE_RELEASE_DIRECTORY" && composer validate --no-check-publish --no-interaction >/dev/null 2>&1; STEP_EXIT_CODE=$?; fi
